result.title: Temporal Weight Surgery: Repairing Video Grounding with LLM Editors
result.comment: 35 pages, 18 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material
result.summary: A surgeon first finds what is wrong, then fixes only that part. We use this idea for video grounding, where video-language models often find the right moment in a long video but write its time wrong. In Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), a general-purpose LLM reads the model's weights and activations, finds where the error arises and repairs it there, without gradients. Separate sessions find the same cause, and this diagnosis of where and why the model fails is our main contribution. Three GPT-6 Astra sessions trace a dropped digit in TimeLens-8B to one MLP layer, and the largest edit gains 7.9 mIoU on 1,215 unseen questions and 18.3 on videos of 30 minutes or more. Two Claude Opus 5.5 sessions trace minutes written as seconds in Qwen3-VL-8B to the separator and gain 2.9 and 1.3. Before any edit, its answers often have the right minute and the wrong separator, and fixing only the separator lifts their mIoU from 13.1 to 19.2. Every improving edit beats a random edit of its size, and the edited models run as fast as before.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Temporal Weight Surgery：让通用 LLM 读取视频语言模型的权重与激活，定位时间定位错误究竟产生在哪一层（如某 MLP 层或时间分隔符），并在无梯度下做最小权重/激活编辑，使时间戳输出得以修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 「找到了正确分钟却写错时间」表现为内部信息与输出映射脱节，其无梯度定位错误来源并按贡献归因做局部干预的思路，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用、以及贡献分配与状态级诊断。
